use default

top(pile: LIST[int]) -> int => pile[pile.count - 1]

patience_sort(values: List[int]) -> Pipe[int] is
    let piles = LIST[LIST[int]]()

    for value in values do
        let placed mut = false

        for pile in piles do
            if !placed /\ top(pile) >= value then
                pile.add(value)
                placed = true
            fi
        od

        if !placed then
            let fresh = LIST[int]()

            fresh.add(value)
            piles.add(fresh)
        fi
    od

    while piles.count > 0 do
        let smallest mut = 0

        for at in 1..piles.count do
            if top(piles[at]) < top(piles[smallest]) then
                smallest = at
            fi
        od

        let pile = piles[smallest]

        yield top(pile)

        pile.remove_at(pile.count - 1)

        if pile.count == 0 then
            piles.remove_at(smallest)
        fi
    od
si

for values in [[5, 3, 1, 7, 4, 1, 1, 20], [2, 1], [8]] do
    write_line(
        "{values |> join(" ")} -> {values |> patience_sort() |> join(" ")}"
    )
